planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno; fixed wiring: DHT11 data on D7, TM1637 CLK on D4 and DIO on D5, error LED on D13, Serial baud 9600.

DHT sampling period must be >=2000 ms for both temperature and humidity on the same physical pin (D7). Invalid reads retain the last valid measurements and set validity false; the SysML model decides when to enter the error state.
TM1637 shows alternating temperature/humidity during normal operation; on any DHT failure it must display 0000, while the LED on D13 flashes according to SysML timing (not encoded here).

Serial output 'sensor error' is required on sensor failure. Since the serial report API here supports numeric/Boolean channel values, the fixed text transmission should be modeled in SysML (do not implement dynamic text construction in code).
No explicit control-deadline was provided; control_period_ms is chosen as 10 ms for scheduling granularity.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个带错误提示的传感器显示系统，使用 DHT11（D7）、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、LED D13 和串口。正常时轮流显示温度和湿度；若读数失败，则数码管显示 0000、LED 闪烁，并在串口输出 sensor error。
